opening: Tiamat rests on a ruined arch at the edge of the clearing. He watches you roll closer.

turns.action: I ask Tiamat how long he has watched this frontier.
turns.narration: Tiamat tilts his silver head. "Longer than your makers have kept records, little machine." His eyes drift over the ruins. "Kingdoms rose here. I watched each one fall."

turns.action: I ask which kingdom he liked best.
turns.narration: A low rumble shakes the arch. "None of them." He pauses. "The one with the lanterns. Their children left bread on my wall each winter."

turns.action: I tell him I will leave bread on the arch tonight.
turns.narration: Tiamat is quiet for a long moment. Then he lowers his head until one eye meets your sensor. "Do that, little machine. I will remember it."

choices: I ask Tiamat what became of the lantern kingdom.
I ask Tiamat about the smoke over the watchtower.
I sit on the arch beside him and wait.
